messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
In November 2028, how often will the IGEA-PRIM overhead travelling crane at position 13 of the IGEA list, built in 2017, have to be verified?

response.text: Nel novembre 2028, con quale frequenza dovrà essere verificata la gru a ponte IGEA-PRIM alla posizione 13 dell'elenco IGEA, costruita nel 2017?
